_README: TEMPLATE. Copy to spikes/evidence/<scenario_id>-<device_id>.json, set scenario_id, fill every field from a PHYSICAL device run, delete all keys starting with underscore. Unfilled (null) fields are INVALID and the scenario stays PENDING. Never set synthetic=true for real evidence; synthetic and emulator/simulator files never count.

REM-AND-00.title: Tauri Android build installs and launches offline on a physical phone
REM-AND-00.pass_criteria: All checks true on two phones from different manufacturers. Record merged-manifest permissions.

REM-AND-01.title: POST_NOTIFICATIONS and channel states reported; ledger stays usable
REM-AND-01.pass_criteria: All checks true on API 33+ devices.

REM-AND-02.title: Exact-alarm access NOT granted: delivery with screen off
REM-AND-02.pass_criteria: Informational: measures the weaker path the plugin falls back to. Passing is not required; the result decides whether reminders are labeled approximate or omitted.

REM-AND-03.title: Exact-alarm access granted, allowWhileIdle on: delivery with screen off
REM-AND-03.pass_criteria: At least 19 of 20 trials within 5 minutes after target, zero duplicate, zero stale, on each device.

REM-AND-04.title: Forced Doze idle: delivery
REM-AND-04.pass_criteria: Same threshold with `adb shell dumpsys deviceidle force-idle` active.

REM-AND-05.title: App swiped from recents: delivery
REM-AND-05.pass_criteria: Same threshold with the app task removed from recents (not Force stop).

REM-AND-06.title: Force stop cancels alarms; app detects and rebuilds on next launch
REM-AND-06.pass_criteria: Plugin pending() reads its own storage, so detection must be verified against `dumpsys alarm`, not pending().

REM-AND-07.title: Reboot: restore of future requests, behavior for past-due requests
REM-AND-07.pass_criteria: Future requests deliver, no dose is written by restore, no duplicates. Past-due behavior (source: re-fired about 15 s after boot) is recorded for a product decision.

REM-AND-08.title: Time-zone change and manual clock change while the app is closed
REM-AND-08.pass_criteria: After reconcile on next launch there are no stale or duplicate requests and no past snapshot changed.

REM-AND-09.title: Exact-alarm access revoked while requests are pending
REM-AND-09.pass_criteria: Android docs say revocation cancels future exact alarms; the app must notice and say so.

REM-AND-10.title: Schedule edit with an old request pending: cancel and replace
REM-AND-10.pass_criteria: Old alarm absent from `dumpsys alarm`, zero stale and zero duplicate deliveries.

REM-AND-11.title: Tap, dismiss, and action never write a dose
REM-AND-11.pass_criteria: Ledger dose-event count and occurrence status are unchanged after every interaction.

REM-AND-12.title: Lock-screen privacy with generic text
REM-AND-12.pass_criteria: No medication name, dose, or condition is visible on the locked screen.

REM-AND-13.title: Restricted battery mode and OEM background limits: delivery
REM-AND-13.pass_criteria: Informational: determines which user-facing battery guidance, if any, is needed.

REM-AND-14.title: Concurrent alarm capacity
REM-AND-14.pass_criteria: Measured capacity recorded; the app's rolling-window cap is not above it.
